subject: physics
content:
An infinite number of point charges, each carrying 1 C charge, are placed along the y-axis at y = 1 m, 2 m, 4 m, 8 m ...............

The total force on a 1C point charge, placed at the origin, is x 103 N.

The value of x, to the nearest integer, is __________. [Take Nm2/C2]
explanation:
for G.P.

= 12 103 N
